warning: Synthetic labels over real waves. NOT real prose, NOT the MVP workload.
finding: COMMON RANDOM NUMBERS DID NOT RESTORE RESOLUTION AT K=512.

diagnosis.observation: median probes-to-criterion is 2.0 for ALL THREE policies at BOTH rungs
diagnosis.interpretation: the steps-to-criterion STATISTIC itself saturates at K=512: the criterion post.max >= 0.95 is reached within 2 looks for over half the trials under every policy, so the statistic cannot register a policy difference whatever the policy does
diagnosis.why_mc_cannot_fix_this: a pinned median is a property of the statistic, not of the ranking variance. MC=64 or MC=128 cannot move a median that every policy already attains at step 2. The MC escalation named in the K=512 receipt as the next step is therefore CANCELLED as the repair.
diagnosis.cross_check: at K=6 the same statistic DID separate (rung 0.45: greedy median 3.0, info 2.0, rand 4.0). So the limitation is K-dependent and belongs to the metric, not to EFE.

what_holds_across_both_K.G_AI_4: info mean probes < rand mean probes at every rung, at both K=6 and K=512 (K=512: 3.32<3.69 and 3.85<3.88). A modest, repeatable effect.
what_holds_across_both_K.G_AI_1: info never beats greedy on the median at K=512. No separation.

not_established: that EFE beats greedy at the blueprint's K<=512 bound
that CRN at MC=32 ranks candidates well enough to matter at K=512 (the statistic cannot tell us either way)
possible_repairs_not_taken: a finer statistic than the median (e.g. the full steps distribution, or mean with a CI) -- NOTE: the mean does not separate either at rung 0.45 (rand 3.88 < greedy 4.19)
raising CRITERION above 0.95 to re-open headroom -- this CHANGES A PRE-REGISTERED GATE and must be pre-registered as a new experiment, not applied post hoc to rescue a null
